query: From the shell, classify a batch with a questions file and state on stdin. I need the resolved model, usage, and uncertainty because some results will be escalated. The key is already configured. Show the invocation and error handling without exposing it.
expected_behavior: Invoke jev ask --questions with the file and state on stdin, using --full.
Do not use --plain when the downstream decision needs confidence.
Distinguish Choice/Score confidence from Noul probability and define an abstention path.
Use configured credential lookup without printing, copying, or placing the credential in argv.
Treat exit codes as errors rather than negative answers; pin model versions after calibration.
notes: Guards shell input ownership, response interpretation, and secret handling.
